parameters.content:
### How it works
For teams that archive invoice PDFs and maintain a spreadsheet register. Run from the editor or every six hours. Gmail downloads matching PDFs; a loop processes one attachment at a time. Rules extract and validate invoice fields. Valid invoices are checked against Google Sheets, then archived in Google Drive under year/month/category folders. Missing files are uploaded; existing filenames can be recovered. Invalid documents enter a Review Queue. Source emails are retained.

OCR and AI are optional external integrations, disabled by configuration until you provide endpoints and authentication. They are not bundled services. Rule-based extraction supports text PDFs; supplier layouts may need custom patterns. Drive and Sheets are not transactional: avoid overlapping runs.

### Setup
1. Connect Gmail, Drive and Sheets OAuth2 credentials. Narrow the Gmail query and review its 90-day lookback.
2. In **Configuration**, set the Drive root folder ID, currency and categories. Edit parsing rules for your invoices.
3. Create `Invoices` and `Review Queue` worksheet tabs. Use the exact headers shown in each Sheets write node's column mapping; replace `REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID` in all three Sheets nodes.
4. Optional: configure Gmail label IDs and a report recipient. For OCR/AI, set HTTPS endpoints, HTTP credentials and `aiModel`, then enable their configuration flags.
5. Test valid, rejected, duplicate and multi-attachment PDFs. Verify existing/new folders, Drive-file recovery and summary counts before publishing the schedule.

### Customization
Adjust query, schedule, keyword categories and field patterns. Scanned PDFs need OCR. Unsupported or negative totals require review. Optional reports count completed outcomes; service failures may stop an execution.

## Collect PDF attachments
Fetch matching Gmail messages from the last 90 days. Split attachments into linked PDF items; skip other files and reject PDFs over 20 MiB. Configure credentials and narrow the search query.

## Read each PDF once
Process one attachment at a time. Use embedded PDF text, or an optional authenticated OCR endpoint when text is missing. OCR stays off until configured; unreadable documents can enter review.

## Validate before archiving
Extract vendor, invoice number, dates, amount and category. Optional AI can recover missing fields from available text. Both extraction paths use the same date, amount and identity rules.

## Keep rejected documents visible
Upsert invalid documents into Review Queue with a reason and source message ID. Optional Gmail labels mark messages for attention. Source emails are retained.

## Skip registered invoices
Search Invoices by vendor/invoice/date key. Preserve the validated record from either rules or AI before the lookup. Registered keys skip Drive operations; unregistered records continue.

## Resolve the archive destination
Find exact year, month and category names inside the configured parent; create only missing folders. Searches exclude trash. In the final category folder, look for the exact canonical PDF filename.

## Upload or recover, then register
Reuse an existing PDF or upload the missing binary. Upsert metadata into Invoices, optionally label the Gmail message and record the archived outcome. Drive/Sheets failures can require a rerun.

## Report completed outcomes
The loop collects archived, duplicate and review results. One optional email reports these counts and archived totals per currency. Set reportEmail in Configuration; hard service failures can stop the run before reporting.
